title: New Ebola vaccine trial launches as outbreak spreads in DR Congo
content:
Results may be months away, but efforts are advancing towards enhanced treatment and the world’s first vaccine for the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, the World Health Organization (WHO) said on Tuesday as deaths and cases rise in the largest ever outbreak on record in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). title: Hunger hampers Ebola response as cases top 3,200 in DR Congo
content:

title: Ebola in DR Congo: Childhood deaths rise; hopes raised over new vaccine
content:

title: Ebola virus reaches displacement camps in DR Congo
content:
